text:
maria: heads up — at ~03:12 UTC we started seeing HSM proxy 500s from gpu-proxy-03 and then a process segfault. auditd has a gap for ~03:15-03:20. anyone oncall?
ashwin: I'm taking it. quick paste of `journalctl -u hsm-proxy -n 80` showing the crash:
```
Mar 23 03:14:58 gpu-proxy-03 hsm-proxy[2145]: token refresh ok
Mar 23 03:15:03 gpu-proxy-03 hsm-proxy[2145]: ERROR native_binding: segfault at 0x0
Mar 23 03:15:03 gpu-proxy-03 kernel: hsm-proxy[2145]: segfault (core dumped)
Mar 23 03:15:04 gpu-proxy-03 hsm-proxy[2146]: audit flush failed: write: no space left on device
```
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-0423-07 — runbook -> https://redwood.internal/incidents/runbooks/hsm-proxy :rotating_light:
jordan: was there an RBAC change around 03:15? could a permission change cause a bad code path (e.g. token refresh failing)?
priya: We pushed an RBAC role-binding change at 03:15 in infra: added `rbac:allow-key-rewrap` to `serviceaccount/infra:redwood-hsm` — it was a config-only apply via CI. I can revert the canary if needed.
ashwin: logs show SIGSEGV inside native lib after the token refresh stacktrace. also, `/var/log/audit/audit.log` has a missing chunk for the 03:15 window — looks like auditd couldn't flush. snippet from audit.log tail:
```
-- logs truncated --
type=USER_CMD msg=audit(1718888100.123:455): pid=10234 uid=0 auid=1000 ses=5 msg='cwd=/srv/app cmd=/usr/bin/kubectl apply -f rbac.yaml'
-- MISSING 03:15 - 03:20 --
type=USER_END msg=audit(1718888604.456:478): pid=10300 uid=0 auid=1000
```
sec-lead: @maria @ashwin do NOT revert anything cluster-wide without collecting forensics. SOC2 requires chain-of-custody and preserved artifacts. steps: capture core, preserve audit logs, snapshot user change events, open vendor ticket.
maria: copied core to secure bucket s3://incidents/1718888642/core.tgz and preserved `/var/log/audit/audit.log` to s3://incidents/1718888642/audit.log.tgz — ACLs set to `sec-oncall` only. also did a canary revert on gpu-proxy-01 only, CPU stabilized and no segfaults there.
priya: the RBAC change was applied by `ci-bot` via terraform run `tf-2024-0423-77` (audit id abcd-1234). I left the diff in the PR comments: https://git.internal/infra/ops/merge/342
jordan: for compliance evidence we need: who executed the terraform, the CI run logs, the k8s audit for the role-binding change, and the binary version of the hsm-proxy that crashed. please bundle.
ashwin: binary version v1.3.8. mitigation step: disabled auto token refresh on the proxy (canary) and the segfault stopped. core + binary + logs uploaded to the incident s3 path. Vendor ticket TKT-8602 opened with HSM vendor, sent stack trace.
sec-lead: good. next actions (short):
- priya: full RBAC audit last 7 days, include who has `hsm-access` and `key-rewrap`
- jordan: assemble evidence package for SOC2 (terraform run, CI logs, k8s audit, S3 artifacts)
- ashwin: vendor coordination + timeline.
Please document all steps in the incident thread and DO NOT delete any artifacts. I'll kick off a compliance notification and update the postmortem template. :thumbsup:
maria: assigning tasks in incident tracker now. will update when vendor responds.
priya: on it — running `kubectl get clusterrolebinding -o yaml | grep -A3 hsm-access` and collecting last-applied annotations.
jordan: once we have confirmation no plaintext key material left the HSM, we can move to a controlled rollback of RBAC if needed and plan a patch window for the proxy native lib.
ashwin: agreed — current status: canary stable, no new errors, vendor triage in progress.
maria: thanks all — I'll follow up with the evidence bundle and next steps for the postmortem.
